name: Pecora Bianca
lede: When the pandemic moved dining outdoors, Pecora Bianca chose Bromic heaters so it could keep sharing Italian food and human connection with its guests.
data: Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric · Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric

hero.caption: The outdoor dining enclosure, heaters along its roof edge. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Pecora Bianca serves Italian food in New York. During the pandemic, its tables moved into outdoor dining structures on the street.
The restaurant wanted to keep up its mission – sharing the joy of Italian food and celebrating human connection – with guests seated outside.
Platinum Smart-Heat Electric and Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric heaters were installed for the outdoor dining. The case study gives no quantities or positions.
